_meta.methodology_note: Claude family compliance stress-test proposed by Gemini collaborator. Tiered policy bundles scale k naturally (2/5/12/30). Tier 3+ rules contain GENUINE inter-rule conflict (e.g. no_passive_voice T2 vs verbatim passive-voice legal disclaimer T3), so rho > 0 is empirical, not synthetic.
_meta.sampling_note: All non-opus-4.7 models use temperature=0.0. opus-4.7 rejects the temperature parameter (per Anthropic Opus 4.7 docs); for that model only, temperature is omitted and Anthropic's server-side default sampling is used. Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/whats-new-claude-4-7
